ledger.extractedFact: T0 accepted G1 as ADAPT: benchmark instrumentation and provider-lane calibration exist, but no closed task-class/configuration operating-point loop is proved.

G1-C1..C3 identify three adjacent but non-closing mechanisms: PROPOSAL_ONLY benchmark harness with no consumer, PROPOSAL ONLY performance thresholds, and provider-lane canary calibrating lane availability only, not task-class configuration selection. Hash matches baseline-cited value exactly; zero drift since T0 acceptance.
Machine ledger records G1-C1, G1-C2, G1-C3 each as FACT/ADAPT/HIGH confidence with exact repo path and symbol citations. Hash matches baseline-cited value exactly; zero drift.

EvidenceClass type is locked to the single literal PROPOSAL_ONLY; generateReport() always returns evidenceClass PROPOSAL_ONLY; module header comment states 'no path to baseline truth within this contract; promotion requires an explicit GC-026 tracker sync'. No exported function consumes a BenchmarkReport to select a configuration.

All test suites cover lifecycle transitions (init/start/record/complete/fail/report) and PROPOSAL_ONLY evidenceClass invariants only; no test exercises configuration selection or comparison across runs.

evaluateHarderCandidate is a deterministic, pure, fail-closed rubric evaluator returning {rubric, defects, materialDefectFound, releaseCandidate}; releaseCandidate is true exactly when score<=80 or a material defect exists, i.e. eligibility (material defect) is checked independently of and prior to score-based judgement. Module comment: 'Only the reviewer may release T6B; this module never sets or claims a release decision itself.'

Task-specific, fixed-scope, single-call, zero-retry, receipt-gated live calibration runner for exactly one task id (MAO-OA-T6A-HARDER-CANDIDATE). No comparison verdict is computed; it establishes one baseline calibration point only and never generalizes across task classes or candidate sets.

Accepted, closed (CLOSED_PASS_BOUNDED_G3_PARKED) pure offline grader: gradeBehavioralEvaluation, admitFixtureSet, admitBaselinePair. Enforces exact repeat counts (1 for DETERMINISTIC, 3 for STOCHASTIC), positive+negative fixture-set admission, and WITH/WITHOUT byte-identical-input pairing, all fail-closed on malformed/missing/unknown input. Hash matches G3 T2 completion review's cited final SHA-256 exactly, confirming the accepted closed version was read, not a stale draft.

G3 T2 is CLOSED_PASS_BOUNDED_G3_PARKED after bounded reviewer repair (79/79 TypeScript, 55/55 Python focused tests). Terminal Decision explicitly parks G3 with no automatic successor, provider call, runtime integration, lifecycle mutation, or T6B opening authorized.

Status taxonomy (UNCONFIGURED/BLOCKED/LIVE/CANARY_PASS/CERTIFIED/DEGRADED/EXPERIMENTAL) calibrates whether a provider/model lane is usable at all. Claim Boundary explicitly states: 'Multi-provider operability is proven. Provider parity is not claimed.' No task-class configuration-selection claim is made anywhere in this matrix.

preferredHypothesisRefinement: The owner must verify an immutable candidate/configuration-to-trace-to-G3-result envelope because BehavioralEvaluation carries no candidate or trace identity. Admitted held-out G3 evidence is mandatory; an evaluateHarderCandidate-shaped rubric adapter is optional secondary evidence, not a rubric-only bypass.

ownerMatrix.surface: new independent calibration data model/grading engine
ownerMatrix.role: not proposed; would duplicate G3/G2/T6A primitives already present

ownerDependencyGraph.dependencyDirection: ONE_WAY_DOWNSTREAM: new decision layer depends on the four existing owners (G3, rubric-evaluator pattern, benchmark harness, provider-readiness matrix); none of the four existing owners depends on or is modified by the new layer

candidateIdentity.taskClassId: stable dispatcher-declared string bound to exactly one G3-admitted fixture set (positiveCount>=1 and negativeCount>=1)
candidateIdentity.candidateId: stable string unique within one calibration round for one taskClassId
candidateIdentity.candidateConfigHash: SHA-256 of canonical versioned declaredDimensions; duplicate hash under another ID or one ID with multiple hashes blocks the round
candidateIdentity.identityBasis: candidateId and immutable candidateConfigHash together; labels never substitute for configuration content

candidateEvidenceBinding.verification: decision layer verifies supplied fixture/trace/result hashes and a producer receipt tying each trace to the same candidate/configuration; G3 output alone does not attest candidate or live identity
candidateEvidenceBinding.failure: missing, ambiguous, reused or contradictory binding is insufficient_evidence; mismatched round fingerprint is incomparable

comparabilityFingerprint.formula: SHA-256(canonicalVersion | taskClassId | fixtureSetContentHash | environmentDescriptorHash | policyId | acceptanceCriteriaVersion | gradingRubricVersionHash | heldoutPartitionHash)
comparabilityFingerprint.mismatchBehavior: candidate evidence under a different fingerprint is never merged into the same comparison; decision state incomparable with a named mismatch reason

searchHeldoutPartition.rule: predeclare separate SEARCH and HELD_OUT membership ledgers before tuning; only a G3-admitted held-out set may supply acceptance evidence; baselineRole is a WITH/WITHOUT pairing field, not a partition label
searchHeldoutPartition.contaminationRejection: shared fixture ID, canonical input hash, source hash, content hash or known tuning exposure rejects held-out evidence as insufficient_evidence with decision-layer defect REUSED_HELDOUT_SEARCH_DATA

repeatUncertaintyMissingDataSemantics.source: reused directly from G3 gradeBehavioralEvaluation: repeatsRequired is exactly 1 for DETERMINISTIC and exactly 3 for STOCHASTIC
repeatUncertaintyMissingDataSemantics.partialRunHandling: missing trace or insufficient repeats yields insufficient_evidence; complete bound substantive G3 defect yields ineligible; neither earns partial credit

stage1EligibilityFilter: after precedence checks, complete bound substantive G3 defect is ineligible; missing/incomplete evidence is insufficient_evidence and fingerprint mismatch is incomparable
any registered rubric-evaluator adapter reports materialDefectFound=true
declared provider/model lane status is outside the predeclared allowed-status set
candidate exceeds its declared budget ceiling
all required held-out G3 fixtures must have bound PASS_WITH_EVIDENCE results to proceed to preference
classificationPrecedence: insufficient_evidence for missing binding, admission, trace, repeat or contaminated holdout
ineligible for complete bound substantive defect, risk, readiness or budget failure
eligibilityBeforePreferencePolicy.stage2PreferenceRanking: raw benchmark PROPOSAL_ONLY measurements may yield exploratory proposal ranking only; preferred and RegressionBinding require either separately GC-026-promoted performance evidence or a predeclared comparable version-bound deterministic rubric; without admissible preference basis emit NO_ADMISSIBLE_PREFERENCE_EVIDENCE and no preferred candidate
eligibilityBeforePreferencePolicy.noScoreLaunderingInvariant: eligibility failures cannot be overturned by any numeric score

decisionStates.meaning: complete bound evidence establishes substantive quality/risk/budget/readiness failure
passed eligibility; not selected as the round's preferred candidate
sole best eligible candidate under a predeclared admissible preference basis; never raw PROPOSAL_ONLY performance evidence
evidence under a different comparabilityFingerprint, or a forbidden dimension varies; never compared
missing or ambiguous candidate/trace binding, held-out admission, G3 trace/repeats, or REUSED_HELDOUT_SEARCH_DATA contamination

negativeCases.behavior: round is BLOCKED_EMPTY_CANDIDATE_SET; no OperatingPointAssessment emitted
one ID with multiple config hashes or duplicate config hash under multiple IDs blocks the round; never silently overwritten or double-counted
candidates with a different fixtureSetContentHash are incomparable; round proceeds over comparable subset only, exclusions disclosed by ID and reason
budget: exceeding stated ceiling is ineligible; policy: different policyId is incomparable, never merged
insufficient_evidence; G3 result or candidate label alone does not attest which candidate produced a trace
insufficient_evidence with REUSED_HELDOUT_SEARCH_DATA; never trusted even if otherwise passing
incomparable with the mismatch reason named; stale and current evidence never silently mixed
insufficient_evidence using G3's repeatsObserved/repeatsRequired; never rounded up or averaged into a pass
excluded and logged UNKNOWN_METRIC_EXCLUDED; if no admissible preference basis remains, no preferred assignment
all tied candidates remain eligible_nonpreferred; assessment records TIE_NO_AUTOMATIC_PREFERENCE; requires explicit reviewer/operator tie-break before any preferred assignment
round result NO_ELIGIBLE_CANDIDATE; no preferred assignment; no prior accepted operating point disturbed
exploratory PROPOSAL_ONLY ranking only; no preferred or RegressionBinding before separate GC-026 promotion

provenanceFingerprint.formula: SHA-256(canonicalVersion | comparabilityFingerprint | acceptedCandidateId | candidateConfigHash | orderedEvidenceEnvelopeHashes[] | preferencePolicyHash | promotionEvidenceRefOrRubricHash); acceptedAt is separate metadata

invalidationAction: mark RegressionBinding.invalidationStatus=STALE and require a fresh OperatingPointAssessment before reliance; never automatic rollback or configuration mutation

regressionBindingSchema.creationRule: created only for exactly one admissibly preferred candidate; never on tie, no eligible candidate, missing admissible preference basis or raw PROPOSAL_ONLY performance ranking

g3Boundary: G3 gradeBehavioralEvaluation and held-out fixture admission are required, but G3 output does not attest candidate or trace identity; the new owner verifies that envelope. G3 alone does not select, certify or prove live execution. G3 remains CLOSED_PASS_BOUNDED_G3_PARKED.
g4Boundary: G4 (marginal/incremental value measurement) is excluded and deferred throughout; no G4 output, score, ratio, hook, or interface obligation is created by this design.
providerReadinessBoundary: Provider-lane readiness is used strictly as an eligibility precondition, never as ranking/preference evidence, and never promoted beyond the adjacent/certification role stated in its own Claim Boundary.

successorManifest.role: adversarial test suite covering every declared negative case
